title.zh: 【富兰克林邓普顿向 XRP Ledger 新增约 1.5 亿美元代币化基金份额，全部集中于单一钱包】
title.en: 【富兰克林邓普顿向 XRP Ledger 新增约 1.5 亿美元代币化基金份额，全部集中于单一钱包】

current_state.zh: Franklin Templeton added roughly $150 million in tokenized money-market fund shares to XRP Ledger, increasing sgBENJI supply there to about 193 million tokens worth approximately $200 million, all held in a single wallet.
